summary: Iteration 32 - Final Comprehensive Social & Privacy Testing for TestFlight Release. Backend: 33/33 tests passed (100%). Fixed critical bug in GET /api/feed endpoint. All social and privacy features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: MongoDB aggregation error in GET /api/feed - 'has_tips: 0' was invalid in inclusion projection. Changed to 'has_tips: {$literal: False}'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final comprehensive test for TestFlight release passed. All social and privacy features verified: hybrid privacy model (global default + per-item override), retroactive privacy updates, friend request flow, user search, user profiles with friendship_status, activity feed with privacy filtering, community feed (only public), leaderboard (public verified points only), like/comment on activities, and performance endpoints (/api/visits/check/{landmark_id}, /api/landmarks with is_visited). Fixed bug in GET /api/feed where MongoDB aggregation used invalid exclusion syntax.

PUT /api/auth/privacy.notes: Retroactive privacy updates work. Changes default_privacy, returns updated_visits and updated_activities counts

PUT /api/visits/{visit_id}/privacy.notes: Changes visibility of specific visit and associated activity

GET /api/users/search.notes: Search users by name or username works

GET /api/friends/pending.notes: Returns pending friend requests from others

GET /api/users/{user_id}/profile.notes: Returns profile with friendship_status, stats, recent_visits

GET /api/feed.notes: Returns activity feed with privacy filtering (after fix for MongoDB aggregation bug)

GET /api/leaderboard.notes: Returns leaderboard, supports time_period, category, friends_only params

bugs_fixed.root_cause: MongoDB aggregation $project stage had invalid syntax 'has_tips: 0' - cannot mix inclusion (1) and exclusion (0) in the same projection
